title: Coarse maximum denominator bound after repeated marked padding
conclusion: There exists a distinct exactly-(r+t) positive integer unit-fraction representation of one containing the exact marker m, with maximum denominator M_t<=(M_0+1)^(2^t)-1.
quantifier_scope: Existence at each integer target length r+t, including t=0; a sequence of outputs is selected using the reviewed construction.
direct_computational_coverage: No arbitrary-iteration computation claimed; universal conclusion is proved by induction from the one-step bound.
